content_sections.heading: Haryana Police SPO Recruitment 2026 Overview
content_sections.text: Register for Job Alerts Important Eligibility Notice: This recruitment is not open to all 12th-pass candidates. It is specifically intended for the notified ex-servicemen and former Constables of the disbanded Haryana State Industrial Security Force (HSISF) and Haryana Armed Police (HAP) Battalions. Preference will be given to applicants experienced in handling telecommunication equipment, especially those who served in the Signal Corps. Vacancy Clarification: The latest press release in the supplied document specifies 170 SPOs, but the accompanying terms, application form and affidavit refer to 400 SPOs. Candidates should confirm that the prescribed forms and terms apply to the 170-post engagement before submission.

content_sections.heading: Haryana Police SPO Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: Candidates must appear in person on the prescribed date at their respective District Police Control Room with the completed application form, original documents, attested photocopies, required affidavits and four passport-size colour photographs. Applications submitted after the prescribed date for the concerned district will not be accepted. Candidates should follow any district-specific instructions published by Haryana Police.

content_sections.heading: Haryana Police SPO Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The Haryana Police Telecommunication Wing has announced engagement of 170 Special Police Officers . The supplied press release does not provide a district-wise or category-wise breakup of the 170 posts. Document Discrepancy: The terms and conditions and prescribed application form attached to the notice mention engagement of 400 SPOs. The vacancy figure should be checked against any clarification issued by the Haryana Police Telecommunication Wing.

content_sections.heading: Haryana Police SPO Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: The attached terms specify 10+2 or equivalent qualification from a recognized board as the minimum educational requirement. Applications are invited from the following categories: Ex-servicemen of the Armed Forces. Ex-servicemen of Central Armed Police Forces (CAPFs). Former Constables of the disbanded Haryana State Industrial Security Force (HSISF). Former Constables of the disbanded Haryana Armed Police (HAP) Battalions. Preference will be given to candidates experienced in operating and maintaining telecommunication equipment, particularly those who have served in the Signal Corps of the Armed Forces or CAPFs. The attached terms specify the following requirements: A minimum of five years of service in the Armed Forces/CAPFs. Candidates must not have been removed or dismissed from service on grounds of indiscipline, misconduct or medical unfitness. The medical category at the time of discharge should be Category A. The character certificate at discharge should be marked Exemplary or Outstanding. The document does not separately explain how the five-year service requirement applies to former Constables of the disbanded HSISF/HAP Battalions. Those applicants should confirm the applicable conditions with the recruiting authority.

content_sections.heading: Haryana Police SPO Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The supplied notice does not state a separate age-relaxation schedule. Candidates should follow the applicable official instructions.

content_sections.heading: Haryana Police SPO Salary 2026
content_sections.text: Selected Special Police Officers will receive a fixed monthly honorarium of Rs. 20,000 . The amount will be deposited directly into their bank accounts. The uniform allowance is intended for two sets of uniforms, shoes and other prescribed uniform articles. No travelling or daily allowance will be provided merely for appearing for document submission or interview. The attached terms provide the following compensation benefits under the prescribed circumstances. These benefits are subject to the circumstances and conditions prescribed in the attached engagement terms.

content_sections.heading: Haryana Police SPO Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The attached recruitment conditions explicitly state that no written examination or physical test will be conducted for engagement as a Special Police Officer. Eligible candidates will be considered through the prescribed scrutiny and verification process. Submission of application and documents in person. Scrutiny of eligibility and relevant service records. Verification of educational qualifications, age and supporting certificates. Character and antecedent verification by the concerned district police authority. Medical examination before appointment. Issuance of appointment letter to selected candidates. Candidates meeting the prescribed service and telecommunication experience criteria may receive preference under the recruitment conditions. Final engagement will depend on eligibility and verification.

content_sections.heading: Haryana Police SPO Engagement Duration and Training
content_sections.text: The engagement is for one year or until regular appointments are made, whichever is earlier , according to the attached terms. Selected SPOs will undergo a 15-day orientation course to familiarize themselves with the requirements of the Haryana Police Telecommunication Wing. This engagement does not constitute an appointment to a permanent regular police post.

content_sections.heading: Haryana Police SPO Posting Details
content_sections.text: The attached recruitment conditions state that SPOs will not be posted at their home police stations. Preference may be given for posting in the candidate's home district, subject to vacancy availability. SPOs may be deployed elsewhere in Haryana for short periods during emergencies. Deployment will be governed by the requirements of the Haryana Police Telecommunication Wing.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Haryana Police SPO Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted in person at the respective District Police Control Room on 5 November 2026. Visit the official Haryana Police Public Notice page at haryanapolice.gov.in/Public_Notice . Locate the notification titled Engagement of 170 SPOs in Haryana Police Telecommunication Wing . Review the recruitment press release, eligibility conditions and prescribed forms. Download and print the prescribed application form and required affidavit format. Fill in the application form accurately, providing personal details, educational qualifications and previous service information. Prepare the relevant original documents and one set of attested photocopies. Arrange the required affidavits and four passport-size colour photographs. Appear in person at the respective District Police Control Room on 5 November 2026 . Submit the application and documents as instructed by the concerned police authority. Important: Candidates must attend personally. Incomplete applications or applications received after the prescribed date for the respective district will not be entertained.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for Haryana Police SPO Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates should bring the following documents and information, as applicable, along with the original certificates and attested photocopies. Duly completed prescribed application form. Four passport-size colour photographs. 10th and 12th educational certificates. Proof of date of birth. Armed Forces/CAPF/HSISF/HAP service and discharge records, as applicable. Service enlistment and discharge dates. Medical category certificate at discharge. Character certificate showing Exemplary or Outstanding status. Aadhaar Card photocopy. PAN Card photocopy. Bank passbook photocopy. Relevant category certificate, if applicable. Prescribed affidavit declaring eligibility and willingness to serve. Other documents required by the recruitment authority. The prescribed affidavit includes declarations concerning residence, previous service, pending criminal cases, earlier SPO engagement in Haryana districts and willingness to serve in the Telecommunication Wing.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Haryana Police to hire eligible candidates for contractual positions within their department in the state of Haryana.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post offered in this notification?
faq.answer: The position available for applicants is Special Police Officer (SPO) under the Telecommunication Wing of the Haryana Police.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 400 vacancies available for the Special Police Officer (SPO) positions across the designated recruitment centers in Haryana.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for these posts?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in. Candidates need to appear in person at the respective District Police Control Room with required documents on the specified date.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to apply or attend the walk-in?
faq.answer: The last date associated with this recruitment notification is 5 November 2026. Applicants should ensure they meet all requirements by this date.

faq.question: Q6. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed 10+2 from recognized boards with prior service as ex-servicemen of Armed Forces/CAPFs or ex-Constables of disbanded HSISF/HAP Battalions.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The age of the candidates must not be less than 25 years and not more than 50 years as on the date of advertisement.

faq.question: Q8. What is the monthly salary for selected candidates?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a monthly honorarium of Rs. 20,000/- along with a onetime uniform allowance and applicable daily travel allowances.

faq.question: Q9. What documents are required for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring a duly filled application form, original documents with attested photocopies, required affidavits, photographs, and identity cards.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is required or mentioned in the official notification for participating in this recruitment process.
